why: UNIVERSES: the project's tangent functor lives on EP.{max u 1}, and B is stated on EP.{1}/EPLoc.{1} with EP.tangent.{0}. So A's theorems on EP(E⁻¹) are taken at u = 0 (objects in EP.{1}). The helper lemmas on unbundled ep-groupoids (tangent_comp, tangent_id, projLeft/Right_comp_wfpLift) are taken at universe 1, where the project's proof uses them for EP.{1}. A is theorem_11_1_1 and its pieces: T(X) = TX and T[d] = [Td]; refinements and equivalent diagrams go to refinements and equivalent diagrams; T preserves 𝟙 and ≫; T ∘ i = i ∘ T. It also has isGeneralizedIso_tangent, isRefinement_tangent_id/comp and the helpers. B says there is a functor T' of EP(E⁻¹) with T'(X) = TX, T'[d] = [Td] (up to eqToHom), and i ⋙ T' = T ⋙ i. A_to_B takes T' = tangentFunctor with hobj = rfl and Functor.ext. B_to_A first shows B's T' equals tangentFunctor (Functor.ext; every morphism is some [d]), then substitutes. Several facts come from B's T' itself: preservation of 𝟙 and ≫, Equiv d d' ⇒ Equiv (Td) (Td') (from T'[d] = T'[d'], cancelling eqToHoms), the square with i, and generalized isomorphisms going to generalized isomorphisms. The refinement statements do not follow from B, because B only sees classes and Equiv does not give a refinement in a prescribed direction. They are re-proved outright together with the unbundled helpers, by copying the project's proofs: tangentMap_comp, theorem_10_1_7, isEquivalence_projLeft and wfpLift. These are finer intermediate steps of the proof, not extra content of the theorem, so the two sides say the same thing.
overlap: HARNESS: A's statement mentions EPLoc.tangentFunctor, whose map well-definedness, map_id and map_comp are proved with the banned Equiv.tangent, isRefinement_tangent_id and isRefinement_tangent_comp (through them IsRefinement.tangent, projLeft_comp_wfpLift, tangent_comp, tangent_id). These are abstracted as tangentFunctor._proof_1..3. Every term mentioning A therefore reaches them, and plain #rt_check fails on both directions (recorded with #guard_msgs). #rt_check_soft passes on both: the banned theorems are reached only through the proof fields of tangentFunctor. B_to_A uses the functor laws of B's T', never tangentFunctor's fields, and A_to_B uses A's conjuncts. rt_overlap B_to_A: 1054 shared project theorems. They are the EP(E⁻¹) and tangent-ep-groupoid machinery in the statements (including the banned ones via tangentFunctor's fields) plus the lemmas of the copied refinement proofs: theorem_10_1_7, IsEquivalence.of_comp_left, isEquivalence_projLeft, src/tgt/conj_wfpLiftMor, tangentMap_comp.
